Black and white aerial photograph of the Chadsey Condon and Core City neighborhoods of Detroit, northwest of downtown Detroit. A major railroad crossing is shown intersecting Grand River Avenue (M-5) Interstate 94, West Warren Avenue, Buchanan Street, and West Grand Boulevard are shown cutting through residential areas in the top half of the photograph. This would be the future site of Interstate 96/Jeffries Freeway. In the lower half of the photograph, West Michigan Avenue  is shown intersecting with the same railway through the neighborhoods of Hubbard Farms and greater Southwest Detroit. There are two major railyards shown in the lower right corner and bottom center of the photograph.
